title: School Zone Flasher Maintenance
description: Use this service request to report or request maintenance or repairs to school zone flashers. ** To request a new school zone flasher use 'Traffic Sign - New - TPW ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

conditionalPaths.instruction: ** Please enter Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TPW **

observedQuestions.question: When did you notice the problem?
What street is the flasher on? (Street name should match request address)
What direction was the problem occurring?
What is the nearest cross street?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Problem = Obstructed; noticed = Other with description; street, school, and cross street supplied; direction = Westbound; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to repair or maintain a school zone flasher.
actions.why: Report a school zone flasher with a burned-out bulb, incorrect flash timing, a head turned away, no flashing, or an obstruction. The 311 request form asks when the problem was noticed and for the street, direction, nearest cross street, and school.
actions.why_not: The online form for "School Zone Flasher Maintenance" requests does not apply to a new school zone flasher or to one knocked down or leaning in traffic. If a new school zone flasher is needed, then submit a "Traffic Sign - New" 311 request instead. If a flasher is knocked down or leaning in traffic, then view the "Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN" 311 guidance instead. If a flasher was hit or knocked down completely and the damage causes a signal malfunction, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "School Zone Flasher Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "School Zone Flasher Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about a knocked-down school zone flasher causing a signal malfunction.
actions.why: For a school zone flasher that has been hit or knocked down completely and its damage causes a signal malfunction. The description for "Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs these reports to 311 by phone.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a new school zone flasher.
actions.why: For requesting installation of a new school zone flasher. The description for "School Zone Flasher Maintenance" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs new flashers to Traffic Sign - New.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign - New"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign - New"

actions.tagline: View Dallas 311 guidance for a school zone flasher knocked down or leaning in traffic.
actions.why: For a school zone flasher that is knocked down or leaning in traffic. The 311 request form for "School Zone Flasher Maintenance" requests points to the Traffic Signal - Knockdown service; the public "Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN" guidance directs people to call 311 by phone when a complete knockdown causes a signal malfunction.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN"
